doc.areaChart_prop_animated:
If true, animates the chart on mount.
@default false
doc.areaChart_prop_data: Data to display in the chart.
doc.areaChart_prop_height:
The height of the chart in pixels.
@default 300
doc.areaChart_prop_keys: Keys in the data objects to render as areas (series).
doc.areaChart_prop_smooth:
If true, draws smooth (monotone) curves instead of straight lines.
@default true
doc.areaChart_prop_stacked:
If true, series are stacked on top of each other.
@default false
doc.areaChart_prop_title: Optional title displayed above the chart.
doc.areaChart_prop_xAxisKey: The key in the data objects used for the X axis labels.
doc.barChart_prop_animated:
If true, animates the chart on mount.
@default false
doc.barChart_prop_data: Data to display in the chart.
doc.barChart_prop_height:
The height of the chart in pixels.
@default 300
doc.barChart_prop_keys: Keys in the data objects to render as bars (series).
doc.barChart_prop_stacked:
If true, series are stacked on top of each other.
@default false
doc.barChart_prop_title: Optional title displayed above the chart.
doc.barChart_prop_xAxisKey: The key in the data objects used for the X axis labels.
doc.funnelChart_prop_animated:
If true, animates the chart on mount.
@default false
doc.funnelChart_prop_data: Data to display in the chart. Each entry represents one funnel stage.
doc.funnelChart_prop_dataKey: The key in the data objects that represents the value of each stage.
doc.funnelChart_prop_height:
The height of the chart in pixels.
@default 300
doc.funnelChart_prop_nameKey: The key in the data objects used for the stage labels.
doc.funnelChart_prop_title: Optional title displayed above the chart.
doc.ganttChart_prop_className: Additional CSS class name for the container.
doc.ganttChart_prop_columnWidth: Width of one time column in pixels. Defaults to a value suited to the view mode.
doc.ganttChart_prop_endDate: End of the visible date range. Defaults to the latest task end date.
doc.ganttChart_prop_onTaskClick: Called when a task bar is clicked.
doc.ganttChart_prop_rowHeight:
Height of one task row in pixels.
@default 40
doc.ganttChart_prop_startDate: Start of the visible date range. Defaults to the earliest task start date.
doc.ganttChart_prop_tasks: Tasks to render as bars in the chart.
doc.gaugeChart_prop_animated:
If true, animates the chart on mount.
@default false
doc.gaugeChart_prop_color: Color of the gauge arc. Defaults to the first chart color.
doc.gaugeChart_prop_height:
The height of the chart in pixels.
@default 200
doc.gaugeChart_prop_label: Text label displayed with the value inside the gauge.
doc.gaugeChart_prop_title: Optional title displayed above the chart.
doc.gaugeChart_prop_value: Current value displayed by the gauge. Clamped between min and max.
doc.heatmap_prop_colorRange:
Colors used for the lowest and highest values.
@default ["var(--wim-color-surface-variant)", "var(--wim-color-primary)"]
doc.heatmap_prop_data: Cells to display. Each entry maps an x/y category pair to a value.
doc.heatmap_prop_height:
The height of the chart in pixels.
@default 300
doc.heatmap_prop_title: Optional title displayed above the chart.
doc.heatmap_prop_xAxisKey: Ordered list of X axis category labels.
doc.heatmap_prop_yAxisKey: Ordered list of Y axis category labels.
doc.lineChart_prop_animated:
If true, animates the chart on mount.
@default false
doc.lineChart_prop_data: Data to display in the chart.
doc.lineChart_prop_height:
The height of the chart in pixels.
@default 300
doc.lineChart_prop_keys: Keys in the data objects to render as lines (series).
doc.lineChart_prop_smooth:
If true, draws smooth (monotone) curves instead of straight lines.
@default false
doc.lineChart_prop_title: Optional title displayed above the chart.
doc.lineChart_prop_xAxisKey: The key in the data objects used for the X axis labels.
doc.pieChart_prop_animated:
If true, animates the chart on mount.
@default false
doc.pieChart_prop_data: Slices to display. Each entry has a name (label) and a value.
doc.pieChart_prop_donut:
If true, renders as a donut chart with a hollow center.
@default false
doc.pieChart_prop_height:
The height of the chart in pixels.
@default 300
doc.pieChart_prop_title: Optional title displayed above the chart.
doc.radarChart_prop_animated:
If true, animates the chart on mount.
@default false
doc.radarChart_prop_data: Data to display in the chart.
doc.radarChart_prop_height:
The height of the chart in pixels.
@default 300
doc.radarChart_prop_indexKey: The key in the data objects used for the axis (category) labels.
doc.radarChart_prop_keys: Keys in the data objects to render as radar areas (series).
doc.radarChart_prop_title: Optional title displayed above the chart.
doc.scatterChart_prop_animated:
If true, animates the chart on mount.
@default false
doc.scatterChart_prop_data: Points to plot. `z` optionally controls the point size.
doc.scatterChart_prop_height:
The height of the chart in pixels.
@default 300
doc.scatterChart_prop_title: Optional title displayed above the chart.
doc.scatterChart_prop_xAxisName:
Name of the X axis, shown in the tooltip.
@default "X"
doc.scatterChart_prop_yAxisName:
Name of the Y axis, shown in the tooltip.
@default "Y"
doc.sparkline_prop_ariaLabel: Accessible label describing the trend; when omitted the sparkline is hidden from assistive tech
doc.sparkline_prop_color: Stroke/fill color (defaults to the primary chart color)
doc.sparkline_prop_data: Sequence of values to plot, in order
doc.sparkline_prop_height: Height of the sparkline in px
doc.sparkline_prop_max: Upper bound of the y-axis domain (defaults to the data maximum)
doc.sparkline_prop_min: Lower bound of the y-axis domain (defaults to the data minimum)
doc.sparkline_prop_showLastDot: Whether to emphasize the last data point with a dot (line and area only)
doc.sparkline_prop_strokeWidth: Stroke width for line and area types
doc.sparkline_prop_width: Width of the sparkline (number in px, or a CSS value such as "100%")
doc.treemap_prop_aspectRatio:
The aspect ratio of the rectangles.
@default 4/3
doc.treemap_prop_data: Data to display in the treemap.
doc.treemap_prop_dataKey: The key in the data objects that represents the size of the rectangle.
doc.treemap_prop_height:
The height of the chart in pixels.
@default 300
doc.treemap_prop_title: Optional title displayed above the chart.
